description: A unified manager for Codex and other AI coding agents, with an extension system and a local model gateway.
notes: The Windows build is not digitally signed.
The Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is required. Install 'extras/webview2' if it is missing.
Codex++ stores its state and logs in %USERPROFILE%\.codex-session-delete; Codex data stays in %USERPROFILE%\.codex unless CODEX_HOME is set.
Use 'scoop update codex-plusplus' rather than the built-in updater.
'scoop uninstall --purge' does not remove the user data directories.
